Subject: Re: ACME kickoff / procurement & security follow-up

Hi John / ACME procurement team —

Thanks again for the time today. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Summary: ACME is evaluating Redwood for inference serving across Product Search and Customer Support (pilot ~5k requests/day). Primary gating items are DPA, SOC 2 evidence, and procurement path (PO vs card; marketplace preferred).
- Deliverables I’ll send: DPA draft, current SOC 2 report, and our standard security questionnaire answers.
- Procurement options we support: corporate card (self-serve), PO + invoice (via finance), and AWS Marketplace listing (we can price/offer via marketplace if desired).

Proposed next steps:
1) I’ll attach DPA & SOC 2 to this thread by EOD and share a short summary of contract route options.
2) John / procurement: confirm preferred commercial path (PO + net30 vs card vs marketplace).
3) If security needs a questionnaire, please attach it and I’ll route to our Security + Legal for answers (2-3 business days typical).

Happy to hop on a quick call with Finance/Legal if that helps.

Thanks,
Marissa
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai | (415) 555-0123

Thanks Marissa — good recap. A couple quick items from procurement/finance side: 

- ACME prefers PO + net30 for deal sizes like this. Using corporate card is possible for pilots but procurement would prefer a PO for pilot scale if we commit to >$5k/month.
- Marketplace would be ideal but finance needs to confirm whether Marketplace billing satisfies our internal cost center rules. If Redwood is on AWS Marketplace, that makes approvals much faster.

Also attaching our security questionnaire — can you confirm who on your side will own answers? We’ll need SOC 2 evidence and a signed DPA before the PO is routed. Timeline-wise we’re targeting vendor approval by next Friday (6/25).

John

John — thanks, got the questionnaire. Attaching the DPA draft and our most recent SOC 2 report for your review.

Short answers up-front:
- Procurement path: we can support PO + net30 and will invoice per the PO. If you prefer Marketplace, we are listed on AWS Marketplace (seller ID: Redwood-Inference) and can provide a Marketplace quote — note that Marketplace can add a short approval step in your billing system but often speeds up vendor onboarding.
- DPA / SOC 2: attached. If you need a redline DPA, we can accept your comments and route to Legal. SOC 2 report is provided under NDA — please confirm if your security process requires a separate NDA; otherwise we can share the full report.
- Questionnaire: I’ll coordinate with Security to complete the spreadsheet; expect a first pass in 48–72 hours.

Next steps: I’ll ping our Security lead and Legal and follow up with an ETA on questionnaire answers by Thursday EOD. If ACME confirms PO route, I’ll share invoice flow and our billing contact to accelerate the PO.

Thanks,
Marissa
